review: Independent source review: compact utility-page UX and attachment status lifecycle
reviewed: DesktopRouter emits matched attachment progress and completion/failure only around a new backend open; an existing open or cached PID failure is not reported as a new attempt.
Completion telemetry clears matching cached progress without being replayed to later subscribers, and does not clear pending worker deadlines.
GUI progress/failure notice remains independent of persistent command status and page-owned pending/error state; normal request acknowledgements retain their existing handling.
Failed backend opens are cached for the session and may reflect partial native setup; event text should describe the backend open attempt, not target-side input consumption.

Rechecked the GUI against its UTF-8 baseline after restoration: non-ASCII code-point counts match exactly (including middle dots, multiplication signs, ellipses, arrow, and disclosure triangles), with no replacement characters; the diff contains only the documented attachment lifecycle, compact utility sizing, and focused regression-test changes.
limitations: Source review only; no Cargo checks or native acceptance claimed. Failed backend-open races and page-pending overlap remain unverified by native acceptance.
